The two versions must have word counts within 20% of each other and each within 25% of the original. Avoid extreme caricature. Return JSON with keys human and ai containing strings. Hello, my name is Theresa Morgan and I believe that statue and lump is one thing. I am a 54-year-old sculptor from Los Angeles, California. The clay has the potential to become the statue and once it is sculpted, it realizes that potential. They are merely different instantiations of the same entity. In my free time, I enjoy reading, hiking, and of course, sculpting. What is your view on the following topic: Statue and lump

 (B) two things
